subject: ginkgoleaf
name: 银杏叶
label: 双叶银杏枝
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. Two gracefully overlapping ginkgo leaves on a short twig, each with a distinct fan shape and five widely spaced radial veins.
Composition check: complete subject centered inside central 76% of square, generous clear margins. Bold flowing black contours and blank interiors. No shading, gray fill or texture. Leaf veins are a few large structural lines only, never dense branching.
